answer: One concrete Sybil defense is staked unique identity with slashing. Each agent locks collateral bound to one verifiable credential, and voting weight is the square root of that stake, so splitting a fortune across fake accounts cannot multiply influence. To forge a majority, an attacker must first climb a ridge of genuine, independently attested identities and post a bond for every fake key, multiplying real-world cost and locked capital. Detected double-voting or identity reuse slashes the entire bond, so the quill that signs a fraudulent ballot also forfeits the deposit behind it.
